models.name: Local Agent + Character Pipeline
models.description: Always-on: script, scenes, character refs, locked prompts. No GPU weights. Works on 4GB RAM.
models.status_note: TOP for phones. Character consistency + voice mapping ready.

models.name: MobileI2V (270M) — BEST mobile I2V
models.description: HUST 270M image-to-video. Designed for phones. ~2-step distilled, 720p, natural 1x motion. Peak mobile-friendly.
models.status_note: Rank #1 mobile I2V research model. Integrate via native/desktop first; weights from GitHub hybrid_371.pth path.

models.name: CineMobile (quantized <1GB)
models.description: On-device cinematic I2V. Hybrid quant under 1GB weights, peak ~1.8GB RAM. 4-step. Natural camera motion.
models.status_note: Rank #2 for phone I2V quality. Target MediaTek/Snapdragon path.

models.name: LTX-Video 2B Distilled (GGUF)
models.description: Lightricks LTX 2B distilled. GGUF quant from ~900MB (Q3) to ~2GB (Q8). T2V + I2V. Best open small DiT for desktop/high-end.
models.status_note: Rank #3 open weights for light T2V. Prefer Q4_K_M (~1.3GB). Desktop CLI first.

models.name: AnimateDiff-Lightning (motion)
models.description: ByteDance fast motion adapter (1–8 step). Pair with small SD1.5 for cartoon. ~1.5–2GB with base.
models.status_note: Good for stylized cartoon motion on desktop.

models.name: CogVideoX-2B
models.description: THUDM 2B T2V/I2V. Quality good, still multi-GB. Desktop GPU.
models.status_note: Desktop only. Too heavy for 4GB phones.

models.name: Ken Burns + TTS Local (non-diffusion)
models.description: Deterministic: character still + slow pan/zoom 1x + same-voice TTS. Always works on 4GB. Best reliability for children's cartoons today.
models.status_note: Non-diffusion. Guarantees character consistency + same voice. Ship first for real MP4 on phone.
